name: env-triage
description: Collect environment facts, verify the interpreter and installed dependencies in parallel, then diagnose and prescribe fixes.

steps.description: Record interpreter path, versions, dependency manifest and key configuration.
Verify the active interpreter, virtualenv and supported version range.
Verify installed distributions and imports match the declared requirements.
Correlate the collected facts into one ranked root-cause diagnosis, even when one probe failed.
Give ordered, reversible repair commands when the environment is unhealthy.
